description: Camo Isole — Colore: Charcoal & gold texture Collezione: The Foxes' Wedding, The Philosopher's Stone, Imago Codice: 5748 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Modern Scala: Small Altezza: 139.5 cm Rapporto: 139.5 cm × 86 cm Toni: Light grey, Black CAMO ISOLE is one of the first original designs developed under the Riad family's direction, a fabric that takes the logic of camouflage and translates it into a Venetian register. Tonal layering and natural forms accumulate across the surface, peppered by island silhouettes rendered in Fortuny's metalli c print . The result is a surface of unusual visual complexity — simultaneously abstract and figurative, with a tonal depth that shifts between colorways from understated fog-and-graphite to vivid multi-color palettes. CAMO ISOLE works just as beautifu lly i n colorful interior applications where conventional patterns would feel too literal and serene environments that want to include a touch of a modern classic .
